query: What do Samsung Galaxy S7 buyers report about SIM activation, unlocking, and compatibility with their carrier?
search_text: What do buyers report about SIM activation, unlocking, and compatibility with their carrier?

rows.text: Misleading product description: phone is locked to Tmobile. I bought the phone because it was supposed to be unlocked. However the device came locked to Tmobile, and all attempts to unlock it failed. I even popped in a current Tmobile SIM card which is not locked to any carrier phone, the unlock did not succeed. To make matters worse, when I asked for a refund, I need to pay for the return shipping, 1even though the item is sold through the Amazon Prime program.

Blacklisted phone. The phone was NOT unlocked as advertised, and when calling AT&T to request the unlock code, was advised the IMEI was blacklisted since the device was reported stolen. Obviously NOT a happy customer and would caution anyone doing business with this seller.
do not buy from this seller. ... what is described on the product description is not true... not Verizon compatible... buyer beware...
Not unlocked.. Not unlocked. Only works with at&t network. Had to change carriers because didn't feel like hasseling with sending it back.

Not unlocked!!. When I received phone could tell it was refurbished definitely scratched up. Also was supposed to be unlocked and tried for 2 weeks to get activated with our carrier but come to find out phone was locked.

I was happy with the s7 active. I was happy with the s7 active. Had to go to my carrier and get a smaller SIM but it does work well. The active is rugged, its been dropped a few times no damage and still works.

I went ahead and replaced the battery and it worked just fine from there. The buyer beware part - about a week ago this device was blacklisted and as such, I am no longer able to use it on my network, or any network when checking the IMEI against their BYOP programs. I had contacted Amazon support, who told me to talk to Samsung support, who told me to talk to Verizon support (as the device was Verizon unlocked for US carrier), who told me to talk to my current carrier company (ATT), who told me to talk to Verizon again. It's been a long time since I've bough this device, and it's been great ever since - which is why the overall review is low but the individual sections are high. The 3rd party seller's name is MobileSpree.

both phones were in good condition and were T-mobile compatible. I ordered one of these phones NEW from seller Mobiles International LLC, and another NEW from the seller Mobile Deals. Despite having the seals to the boxes broken, both phones were in good condition and were T-mobile compatible. A charger, earphones, a tool to open the SIM card slot, and related booklets all came within the boxes. However, unlike the Mobiles International LLC phone, the phone I received from Mobile Deals did not come with a SIM card. Mobile Deals phone: 3/5 Mobiles International LLC phone: 5/5

Beware: NOT factory unlocked - TMobile Branding, DEMO serial number. The phone works fine, however NOTHING about this phone is as advertised except - manufacturer (Samsung) - the digit immediately following "S" (7) The phone came unlocked (not factory), has a T-Mobile startup screen and carrier apps installed. Your mileage may vary, but phones from this seller appear to be HIGHLY INCONSISTENT based on numerous other reviews of this product. ALSO: The actual serial on the phone I received is a G930X which is a *DEMO* (re: floor display model) designed to be sent out to retail stores. These are known to have lots of issues properly reading sim cards. thankfully this one works just fine. whoever flashed this thing knew what they were doing.

Great Purchase. I purchased this phone from LTE Warehouse. I was hesitant at first because all the phones say they are compatible, but sometimes they aren't. When I received the phone I realized I had the wrong size sim card, so I had to go down to Verizon. When the guy took the phone out of the box, he said it had the wrong ESIN on the back for Verizon, BUT the phone was compatible with their network. So, the phone does work with Verizon... Not sure what carrier it was supposed to be for, but it works and that is all that matters.
Got an AT&T locked phone from mobile deals. The seller mobile deals sent me a locked s7. No APN access and wanted a unlock code upon getting sim. Don't buy unless you are using at&t.

Only 1 to 0 bar phone signal. Is either refurbirshed or not unlocked.. S7 phone was either not unlocked, or was refurbished. Only 1 to 0 bar phone signal (compared to 3 bars with another S7 that we have). When our carrier sim card was put in, the network was not recognized. A replacement phone was shipped to us the next day. Exactly same issues as before. After countless hours of frustration with our phone carrier, the phones were sent back. We purchased the unlocked S7 from another place and everything works great.
Unlocked for only certain carriers. Doesn't work with Verizon. Useless to me

I like it!. I like it because I was able to activate it with my carrier and it works fine. When I bought it, I bought from this seller for a main reason; on the description it is written: '1 Year Warranty', but when I tried to confirm this with the seller they said that it was not. I can totally live with it or in this case without it. smile

Very disappointed by this misrepresentation. This phone said it was unlocked and never mentions a word about a specific carrier you have to use. We are with sprint but apparently this phone has to be used with AT&T only. Very disappointed by this misrepresentation.
THIS PHONE WAS NOT UNLOCKED. IBUZZ sold me an"unlocked" phone that was absolutely still carrier locked. This costs me additional money to unlock as I am not in the US.

Watch out!!. So the"unlocked" phone i was sold was reported stolen at some point so I wasunable to activate it. Now hopefully they will return my money to me when I return their stolen phone. Otherwise there's going to be an entirely new bigger issue
100% unsatisfied. Phone was NOT unlocked, making it 100% unusable. Was told by my carrier that it was a at&t phone and I needed the original user data to unlock.

No SIM - luckily I had a backup. The SIM card was missing when the item arrived. Luckily my old phone's SIM was compatible. After two tries with customer service, the phone was working. It would have only taken one session, but the first person refused to activate the SIM and wanted me to buy a new one. I suspect they were trying to keep their handle time low. I upgraded from a Galaxy S5. So far I'm pleased with the performance of this phone. Three stars because the product was missing the piece needed for the phone to work!
Not unlocked - Metro Pcs Sim not accepted. The phone does not seem to be unlocked. Used an active metro pcs sim but I get the message "Phone not allowed MM#6".
